The economist Joseph Stiglitz won a prize in 2001.

Soviet troops held on at Stalingrad through the winter.

notes: Card: ' St' x13, 'ö' x2, ' st' x2, '-St', '雷', 'レ'. Probes: Stimson 0.942, Stachouwer 0.683, Stalingrad 0.218 (in a sentence-opening question); ' Stone' 0.005, Morgan 0.018, Berlin 0.014. Tokens are checked. Near misses use whole-token names in the same frames.
